name: Checking
description: Business checking account.

name: Accounts Receivable
description: Money customers owe the business.

name: Undeposited Funds
description: Customer payments awaiting deposit.

name: Equipment
description: Business equipment recorded as an asset.

name: Accumulated Depreciation
description: Accumulated depreciation of business equipment.

name: Accounts Payable
description: Unpaid vendor bills.

name: Sales Tax Payable
description: Sales tax collected and owed to tax agencies.

name: Opening Balance Equity
description: Temporary offset for opening balances; review with your accountant.

name: Owner's Equity
description: Owner contributions and capital.

name: Owner's Draw
description: Owner withdrawals; not a business expense.

name: Services
description: Schedule C: Gross receipts or sales from services.

name: Sales
description: Schedule C: Gross receipts or sales from goods.

name: Reimbursed Expenses
description: Schedule C: Customer expense reimbursements included in gross receipts.

name: Other Income
description: Schedule C: Other business income.

name: Cost of Goods Sold
description: Schedule C: Cost of goods sold (Part III).

name: Advertising
description: Schedule C: Advertising.

name: Car and Truck
description: Schedule C: Car and truck expenses; business use only.

name: Commissions and Fees
description: Schedule C: Commissions and fees.

name: Contract Labor
description: Schedule C: Contract labor.

name: Insurance
description: Schedule C: Insurance other than health insurance.

name: Interest
description: Schedule C: Business interest; separate mortgage and other interest when preparing taxes.

name: Legal and Professional
description: Schedule C: Legal and professional services.

name: Office
description: Schedule C: Office expense.

name: Rent or Lease
description: Schedule C: Rent or lease; separate equipment and other business property when preparing taxes.

name: Repairs and Maintenance
description: Schedule C: Repairs and maintenance.

name: Supplies
description: Schedule C: Supplies not included in cost of goods sold.

name: Taxes and Licenses
description: Schedule C: Business taxes and licenses; excludes personal income taxes and sales tax collected.

name: Travel
description: Schedule C: Travel expenses.

name: Meals
description: Schedule C: Business meals; record the full business cost and apply tax limits when preparing taxes.

name: Utilities
description: Schedule C: Utilities.

name: Wages
description: Schedule C: Wages paid to employees; excludes owner draws.

name: Bank Service Charges
description: Schedule C: Other expenses (Part V), business bank service charges.

name: Depreciation
description: Schedule C: Depreciation and section 179 expense; review asset treatment when preparing taxes.

name: Other Expenses
description: Schedule C: Other expenses (Part V); describe each category when preparing taxes.
